sources.title: DmxModel: Model Wrapping and Configuration | d-matrix-ai/dmx-compressor ...
sources.snippet: The DmxModel layer serves as the primary entry point for the dmx-compressor library. It provides a wrapping mechanism for standard PyTorch models, enabling them with hardware-aware simulation capabilities, quantization, and sparsity. This layer manages the lifecycle of model transformation, from initial symbolic tracing to the application of fine-grained compression configurations.
